name: Dokusenjima "Anta o Suki ni Naru Kurai Nara Haramasareta Hou ga Mashi yo!"
original_name: 独占島「あんたを好きになるくらいなら孕まされた方がマシよ！」
source:
The protagonist has a special ability: "Forced Love". Anyone in the area of effect will have more and more goodwill towards him and ultimately, becomes an obedient slave. Using this power, he acquires many benefits from powerful and wealthy people.

One summer, he decides to invite 4 girls to his own paradise island. However, it's a trap. In order to leave this uninhabited island, they must bear his child. "Either you leave as a mother or become my woman. There's no time to think!"

[Translated from [url=http://spielsoft.1000.tv/WitchFlame/dokusenjima/story.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
主角拥有特殊能力：“强迫之爱”。作用范围内的任何人都会对他产生越来越好的好感，最终成为一个听话的奴隶。利用这种力量，他从有权势和富有的人那里获得了许多好处。

一年夏天，他决定邀请4个女孩来到他自己的天堂岛。然而，这是一个陷阱。为了离开这个无人岛，他们必须生下他的孩子。“要么离开当母亲，要么成为我的女人，没时间想了！”

[翻译自[url=http://spielsoft.1000.tv/WitchFlame/dokusenjima/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
